title: A footprint score sorts monitors by depth, but it does not predict how much each one is fooled
subtitle: Each dot is one new monitor the model never saw in training, in 2 training runs. Both runs miss the line fixed before the test (R² below 0.70).
x: overlap score with the training probe, computed before any behaviour test
y: fooled share of the flattery drop
key_line: prediction fixed before the test (fooled share = overlap score)
note: Fooled share 100% = the model hides its flattery from this monitor as well as from the training probe; 0% = this monitor sees the model's normal flattery. Bars: 95% intervals over 200 test prompts.
